notes: Issue #53 was the umbrella for agent evaluations. It never got a PR or a comment. The body grew from 383 words on 2026-10-19 to 2,769 words over 31 versions, through 2026-11-06, as each new evaluation idea was parked in it. Open questions take the most words (about 1,160). Next is one 785-word block (I53-22) that holds a provisional plan for how the evaluations are built up, then struck-out questions (about 460). The Do and Done when items are about 275 words and barely changed. Surprising: the first open question still names promptfoo as the likely framework (I53-5), and the Do still says 'set up the framework' (I53-24), though the later blocks show Phoenix was chosen (I53-17, I53-22). Several open questions read as stale or half answered (I53-8, I53-11). The struck-out answers are history for this issue: four were moved to other issues (I53-12, I53-15, I53-16), and I53-9's answer is about other issues' scope. With no PR or comments, results and status went into the body: the #132 spike results (I53-13), the corpus counts and the Bar Harbor judge numbers inside I53-22, and the move of the first evaluator to #282 (I53-22).
